locations.note: Jacobs is woken in his apartment in occupied Montrose and put on a bus to a re-education camp; resistance fighters ambush it, and most of the campaign is fought in and around the walled town.
The final campaign chapter takes the resistance to San Francisco.
The finale is a ground, anti-aircraft and air assault to retake the bridge, where Connor Morgan calls an airstrike on the enemy convoy and sacrifices himself.

routes.name: The resistance
routes.note: From occupied Montrose to the assault on the Golden Gate Bridge.
